parameter_matrix.note: Wider operating Vin window supports broader rail & battery chemistry headroom.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TPS7A0233PDBVR supplies up to 200 mA (p.5) compared to AP2112K-3.3TRG1 at 600 mA (p.8); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
BENCH VERIFICATION: Confirm thermal dissipation margin using θJA (AP2112K-3.3TRG1: 184 °C/W vs TPS7A0233PDBVR: 181.9 °C/W) and worst-case ambient temperature (-40..85 °C vs -40..125 °C).
engineering_verdict: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TPS7A0233PDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required replacements: while the footprint is physically compatible, engineering review and passive/circuit adjustments are mandatory due to Iout,max rating drops >20%. Key datasheet deltas: Iq is 55 µA (p.8) vs 0.025 µA (p.6), max output current is 600 mA (p.8) vs 200 mA (p.5), recommended Vin,max is 6 V (p.3) vs 6 V (p.5), typical dropout is 250 mV (p.8) vs 270 mV (p.6), and ceramic capacitor stability is supported vs supported. Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 184 vs 181.9 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
